attributes.title: School Social Work Symposium 2027
attributes.series: NASW Maryland School Social Work Symposium
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Maryland Chapter
attributes.summary:
NASW Maryland's School Social Work Symposium is set for Friday, October 15, 2027, and will be held virtually. The chapter has published the date as a save-the-date on its continuing education page; topics, fees and CE hours were not yet listed when we checked.

The symposium is aimed at social workers in public and private schools, who deal with student mental health, attendance, special education teams, crisis response and family engagement. A one-day online format fits the school calendar and lets staff attend without leaving their district.

NASW Maryland labels its programs by Maryland CE category, and members receive free or discounted CE at chapter events. School social workers licensed outside Maryland should confirm that their board accepts the chapter's CE before registering.
